notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental beginning/ending are the total governmental funds fund balances (601,215 / 807,151) that the p5 statement rolls forward; they include due from other funds 235,000 and notes receivable 74,232 (cash alone is 560,325 + 11,718 + 108 per p4). Transfers_in 139,527 = net transfers from the utilities fund (General 52,126, Golf 54,799, Housing 2, Street 32,600); utilities side shows (139,527) on p3, p7 and p8. Business-type: lines and balances come from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7, report p11, Utilities Fund; added by the v8 re-trim), accrual, measure net position: 1,803,774 + 511,360 - 451,893 (incl. depreciation 82,701) - 139,527 transfers = 1,723,714. This replaces the earlier figures taken from the modified cash Statement of Activities (p2-3: charges 503,403, expenses 627,699 incl. capital purchases 270,360) and the cash roll-forward 80,415 -> 62,682 (cash flow p8, incl. 235,000 due to other funds), which were used only because p7 was not trimmed. The p6 proprietary Statement of Net Position (accrual, net position 1,723,714, ties to p7) differs from the government-wide modified cash column and was not used for balance_sheet. Balance sheet (re-check 2026-10-29, user rule 2026-10-27): governmental lines come from the Governmental Funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Fund Balances p4 (Total Governmental Funds column; fund balance by classification: Restricted 108 (Housing), Unassigned 807,043) because its totals (assets 881,383, liabilities 74,232, fund balance 807,151) equal the government-wide Governmental Activities column on p1; business-type lines stay from the p1 Business-Type Activities column, and the printed totals are the p1 Total column (944,065 = 309,232 + 634,833). Detail = p9 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Funds (outside-review recheck): lines that mix fund types were split with split_from using the governmental (p5) and utilities (p2/p3) figures, with budget_final on the first split item only; the governmental lines tie to p5 in full (expenditures 1,508,893) and Proprietary 627,699 to the utilities expenses on p2. Nursing Home Charges 7,652,819 and Nursing Home 6,697,509 are not in the basic statements; recorded as business-type with review and a decision_needed entry, together with the residuals (grants 7,995, interest 4,743, Miscellaneous spending 4,253) that match no basic statement. Transfer cross-check done: governmental net transfer ties to utilities outflow. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p7) replace the combined schedule. Read pages 1-10 of 10

decision_needed.question: The all-funds budget schedule (p9) includes Nursing Home Charges 7,652,819 and Nursing Home spending 6,697,509 (plus residual grants 7,995, interest 4,743 and miscellaneous spending 4,253), but no nursing home fund appears in the city's basic statements. Is the nursing home part of the City of Stanton's reporting entity (business-type), or a separate entity budgeted with the city? A separate filing exists (Stanton_Nursing_Home_FY2025, FYE 2025-06-30, receipts 7,638,335 / disbursements 7,035,245), so summing detail across reports could double count these lines.
